CustomField.description: The AWS region used for Amazon SES API calls. Determines the SES endpoint URL (e.g., us-east-1 → https://email.us-east-1.amazonaws.com). Updated automatically when AWS credentials are saved via the setup wizard.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The AWS region where your SES resources are configured (e.g., us-east-1, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1). This is updated automatically during setup.
CustomField.label: AWS Region
